description: The web guard in the experimental layout's MUI user menu: viewer with the probe's Kid role in the experimental layout (localStorage 'layout' = 'experimental' before the bundles run, an init script). The user menu's Profile (its first item) and Quick Connect are hidden and aria-disabled; opened with the pointer and with Enter on the avatar, the focus lands on the first visible item (the focus fix: without it MUI leaves it on the menu's paper) and the arrow keys move between visible items only; the Settings page hides the locked links; the late-rendered Display page's Display (account) fields are disabled, the layout selector enabled; the pages a locked user can open save through their own forms: the experimental Display page unchanged (viewer's document holds neither Display (account) key, which the probe arranges), Playback and Subtitles say nothing beyond jellyfin-web's own toast, a locked Display field changed (enabled by script, then clicked) is kept with the header and the guard's toast; a typed locked URL and one behind a second '#' end on Home. The form saves change nothing in the end.

steps.name: the experimental layout
a recorder of the settings saves' answers (method, path, status, X-AccessRoles-Kept), before any page script
steps.initScript: (() => { window.__jfarSaves = []; const f = window.fetch; window.fetch = function (input, init) { const p = f.apply(this, arguments); const url = String((input && input.url) || input); const method = String((init && init.method) || (input && input.method) || 'GET').toUpperCase(); if (method !== 'GET' && /\/(DisplayPreferences|Users)\//.test(url)) { p.then((r) => { window.__jfarSaves.push({ method: method, path: url.replace(/^.*?\/\/[^/]+/, '').split('?')[0], status: r.status, kept: r.headers.get('X-AccessRoles-Kept') }); }, () => {}); } return p; }; })()

steps.name: sign in as viewer
viewer's id
the guard has viewer's /Me, the MUI app bar is up
open the user menu with the pointer
the menu: items, their state, the focus
steps.eval: (() => { const m = document.getElementById('app-user-menu'); const items = [...m.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitem"]')].map((i) => ({ text: i.textContent.trim(), href: i.getAttribute('href'), hidden: getComputedStyle(i).display === 'none', aria: i.getAttribute('aria-disabled') })); const a = document.activeElement; return { items, active: a ? a.textContent.trim() : null, activeHidden: a ? getComputedStyle(a).display === 'none' : null }; })()

steps.name: Profile hidden and aria-disabled, Settings shown, the focus on a visible item (the focus fix)
steps.assert: (() => { const p = __vars.menu.items.find((i) => (i.href || '').indexOf('#/userprofile') === 0); const s = __vars.menu.items.find((i) => i.href === '#/mypreferencesmenu'); return !!p && p.hidden && p.aria === 'true' && !!s && !s.hidden && __vars.menu.active && __vars.menu.activeHidden === false && __vars.menu.items.some((i) => i.text === __vars.menu.active && !i.hidden); })()

ArrowDown
the focus after ArrowDown
steps.eval: (() => { const a = document.activeElement; return { text: a ? a.textContent.trim() : null, hidden: a ? getComputedStyle(a).display === 'none' : null, inMenu: !!a && document.getElementById('app-user-menu').contains(a) }; })()

steps.name: ArrowDown moved to another visible item
close the menu
open it with Enter on the avatar (the keyboard)
Enter
the focus is on a visible item of the open menu
steps.assert: (() => { const a = document.activeElement; const m = document.getElementById('app-user-menu'); return !!a && m.contains(a) && a.getAttribute('role') === 'menuitem' && getComputedStyle(a).display !== 'none' && a.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true'; })()

steps.name: close it
open the Settings menu
the Settings menu is shown
the locked links hidden, Display and Sign out shown
steps.assert: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#myPreferencesMenuPage:not(.hide)'); const d = (s) => { const e = p.querySelector(s); return e ? getComputedStyle(e).display : 'missing'; }; return d('.lnkUserProfile') === 'none' && d('.lnkHomePreferences') === 'none' && d('.lnkControlsPreferences') === 'none' && d('.lnkDisplayPreferences') !== 'none' && d('.btnLogout') !== 'none'; })()

steps.name: open Display
the experimental Display page renders (late)
Display (account) fields disabled, the layout selector enabled
steps.assert: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('input[name="displayMissingEpisodes"]'); const e = document.querySelector('input[name="episodeImagesInNextUp"]'); const l = document.querySelector('input[name="layout"], [name="layout"]'); return m.disabled === true && (!e || e.disabled === true) && !l.disabled; })()

steps.name: viewer's configuration and usersettings document before the form saves
the precondition: neither Display (account) key stored (the probe took them out)
a recorder of every toast, jellyfin-web's and the guard's
steps.script: window.__jfarToasts = []; new MutationObserver(() => { document.querySelectorAll('.jfar-toast, .toast').forEach((t) => { const s = t.textContent.trim(); if (s && !t.__jfarSeen) { t.__jfarSeen = true; window.__jfarToasts.push(s); } }); }).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true }); return true;

steps.name: the experimental Display page saved unchanged through its own form
steps.script: window.__jfarSaves.length = 0; window.__jfarToasts.length = 0;  document.querySelector('input[name="displayMissingEpisodes"]').closest('form').querySelector('button[type="submit"]').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); return { saves: window.__jfarSaves.slice(), toasts: window.__jfarToasts.slice() };

steps.name: nothing kept, no 'weren't changed' toast, jellyfin-web's 'Settings saved.' (once a false toast)
steps.assert: __vars.displaySame.saves.length > 0 && __vars.displaySame.saves.every((s) => s.status < 300 && !s.kept) && !__vars.displaySame.toasts.some((t) => t.indexOf('so they weren') >= 0) && __vars.displaySame.toasts.includes('Settings saved.') && __vars.displaySame.saves.some((s) => s.path === '/DisplayPreferences/usersettings')

steps.name: Display saved with a locked field changed (Display missing episodes, enabled by script, then clicked)
steps.script: window.__jfarSaves.length = 0; window.__jfarToasts.length = 0; const box = document.querySelector('input[name="displayMissingEpisodes"]'); box.disabled = false; box.click(); document.querySelector('input[name="displayMissingEpisodes"]').closest('form').querySelector('button[type="submit"]').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); return { saves: window.__jfarSaves.slice(), toasts: window.__jfarToasts.slice() };

steps.name: the server kept it, answered X-AccessRoles-Kept: DisplayAccount, and the guard's toast says so
steps.assert: (async () => { const c = (await ApiClient.getUser(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId())).Configuration; return c.DisplayMissingEpisodes === __vars.formBefore.config.DisplayMissingEpisodes && __vars.displayLocked.saves.some((s) => /\/Configuration$/.test(s.path) && s.status === 204 && s.kept === 'DisplayAccount') && __vars.displayLocked.toasts.includes('Some of these settings are managed by your server administrator, so they weren\'t changed: Display (account).'); })()

steps.name: nothing kept, no toast but jellyfin-web's
viewer's usersettings document put back as it was before the form saves (the merges keep its locked keys)
steps.script: await ApiClient.updateDisplayPreferences('usersettings', __vars.formBefore.prefs, ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), 'emby'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); return true;

steps.name: the document and the configuration are as they were (AudioLanguagePreference, SubtitleLanguagePreference and CastReceiverId never set taken as empty: jellyfin-web's forms post an empty text for them)
steps.assert: (async () => { const id = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const sorted = (o) => JSON.stringify(Object.keys(o || {}).sort().map((k) => [k, o[k]])); const blank = (c) => Object.assign({}, c, { AudioLanguagePreference: c.AudioLanguagePreference || '', SubtitleLanguagePreference: c.SubtitleLanguagePreference || '', CastReceiverId: c.CastReceiverId || '' }); const prefs = await ApiClient.getDisplayPreferences('usersettings', id, 'emby'); const config = (await ApiClient.getUser(id)).Configuration; return sorted(prefs.CustomPrefs) === sorted(__vars.formBefore.prefs.CustomPrefs) && sorted(blank(config)) === sorted(blank(__vars.formBefore.config)); })()
